channel.title: Searchscope Blog
channel.description: Writing on search systems, algorithm updates, AI search and search data.

item.title: Names you weren't getting credit for
item.description: AI engines don't always use your full company name. Searchscope now spots the variants your saved brand names miss, and offers them for approval with the evidence attached.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: All six AI engines, live
item.description: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Claude and Gemini are all part of every visibility run. They disagree more than you'd expect, which is the point.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: The Content Planner
item.description: One plan for everything you're creating, across SEO and PR, built from the data Searchscope already holds about you. Each piece hands off to Content Studio to build.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: Send any strategist reply to Content Studio
item.description: Every Strategic Advisor reply now carries a Send to Studio action, and the whole conversation travels with it rather than a single message.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: A rebuilt AI visibility overview
item.description: Your score, how often you're named and cited, your share of voice, and where you land inside the answer. Every number shows what it's out of.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: Worksheets
item.description: Any workspace can become a live sheet your team works through, with status, priority and notes. Generate recommendations for many rows at once, with a preview first.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: Prompt suggestions from your own search data
item.description: Searchscope turns the searches that already bring people to your site into the questions buyers ask AI, then checks how often people actually ask them.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: A demo on every page
item.description: Seventeen narrated walkthroughs, one for each surface, played from a Watch demo button on the page you're actually looking at.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: SEO is now an operating system
item.description: For two decades SEO came in projects (audit, fix, wait). That model breaks the moment search starts changing faster than you can audit it. Here's the shift.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: What AI Overviews change about visibility
item.description: You can rank #1 and lose the click. You can be absent from the ten blue links and still be the source an AI quotes. Position was always a proxy; now it's a leaky one.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: Cannibalization is a data problem
item.description: Most cannibalization advice is just vibes (merge the pages that feel similar). But it's visible in the data, page by page, query by query. Here's how to actually find it.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: Reading demand vs. your share
item.description: The single most useful view in search isn't rankings or traffic. It's market demand plotted against the share you actually capture. It shows you where the growth is hiding.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: The co-pilot model for search teams
item.description: AI won't replace your search team, and a search team without AI is about to be outpaced. The model that wins is neither. It's a co-pilot. Here's what that actually means in practice.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)
